title: Canonical profinite coordinate projection of an absolute test scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $S$ a profinite set in the same universe. Let $X[S]=\operatorname{Spec}LC(S,\mathbb Z)\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb Z}X$ be the absolute profinite test scheme [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]. Define the canonical continuous projection $\rho_{X,S}:|X[S]|\to S$ as the composite of the underlying continuous map of the first fibre-product projection $X[S]\to\operatorname{Spec}LC(S,\mathbb Z)$, the inverse of the canonical homeomorphism $S\times|\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb Z|\cong|\operatorname{Spec}LC(S,\mathbb Z)|$ induced by evaluation of locally constant functions, and the first product projection to $S$. No affineness or nonemptiness hypothesis on $X$ or $S$ is imposed.
